Headings with no Latin letters or digits now get a real chunk ID instead of an empty one. `npm run check` and `npm run retrieval-check` both pass.

**The fix** (`src/handbook-chunker.ts`): when a heading's slug comes out empty, the chunker uses `section` instead.
